_meta.source: Live DOM + computed-style extraction from classroom.google.com, 2026-09-23
_meta.designSystem: Google Material 3 (Material You) with Classroom-specific overrides
_meta.note: Every value below was read off the real product with getComputedStyle, not eyeballed. Hex values are the sRGB equivalents of the captured rgb() strings.

surfaceContainerLowest.role: cards, dialogs on white pages, post cards

surfaceContainer.role: dialog background (Create class, Customize appearance, Join class)

surfaceContainerHigh.role: filled text field background, tonal cards, condensed stream rows

surfaceContainerHighest.role: disabled button fill, grey theme swatch

onSurfaceVariant.role: secondary text, inactive icons, class code

primary.role: links, active tab label, primary text buttons

primaryContainer.role: active nav pill, 'New announcement' tonal pill

secondaryContainer.role: selected drawer item, tonal buttons, segmented selection

filledButton.role: Create / Assign / Done primary filled buttons

error.role: required-field label, error underline, error helper text

themeSwatches: see themes-and-colors.json (8 class theme colours with fill + 2px ring)

fontFamily.note: Clone substitute: use 'Google Sans Text'/'Product Sans' if licensed, otherwise Inter or Roboto — metrics are closest with Roboto.

scale.name: headline-lg
scale.use: page/dialog titles, class code value on cards, settings section headings

scale.name: headline-md
scale.use: banner section line, empty-state titles, class code

scale.name: body-lg
scale.use: menu items, text-field input, dialog body

scale.name: label-sm
scale.use: titlebar section line, captions, dense labels

letterSpacing.note: applied globally on body — 238 of the captured elements carry it

weights.note: 400 dominates (297 of 304 captured elements); 500 for active tab + titlebar class name

radiusFull.use: nav pills, buttons, chips, segmented control, FAB

radiusM.use: tonal pill buttons (40px tall), nav pill height 32/40

radiusXS.use: class cards, theme tiles, condensed stream rows, tonal sub-cards

radiusMenu.use: dropdown menu surfaces; filled text field top corners (4px 4px 0 0)

elevation.level0: none — most M3 surfaces here are flat, differentiated by tonal background only
elevation.note: Menus and dialogs in current Classroom use NO box-shadow; they rely on tonal surface colour + scrim.

breakpoints._note: Observed by measuring the nav element width at several viewport widths. Approximate to +/- 20px.

compact.nav: hidden; hamburger opens a MODAL drawer over a scrim
compact.layout: single column, cards full-bleed, 'Add class' renders as a tonal pill instead of a text link

medium.layout: single content column, class cards fixed ~300px in a wrapping grid

expanded.layout: class page shows left sidebar + main column side by side

navDrawerBehaviour.hamburger: toggles the drawer. At >= expanded width it toggles between the 347px expanded drawer and a 72px icon-only rail, and the content reflows. Below that width it opens/closes a modal drawer over a scrim.
navDrawerBehaviour.state: persisted per user across page loads
navDrawerBehaviour.activeItem: full-width pill, bg #D3E3FD (or #C2E7FF on the rail), radius 9999 (rail uses 0 20px 20px 0), icon + label in #0B57D0 / #2962FF

motion.dialogEnter: ~150-200ms fade + slight scale-up from ~96%; scrim fades in over the same window
motion.pageLoad: indeterminate 4px linear progress bar pinned directly under the titlebar, Google blue on a light blue track
motion.sectionLoad: circular indeterminate spinner, ~48px, Google blue, centred in the region
motion.skeleton: grey rounded pills (#E8EAED-ish) in the shape of the incoming rows
